newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific files shelf for $1 bln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific files shelf for $1 bln in debt.

text.p: Union Pacific Corp said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in debt securities.

The net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repayment of borrowings, working capital, capital expenditures, stock repurchase programs and acquisitions, the company said in the filing.
The Bethlehem, Penn., based company operates, through its subsidiaries, in the areas of rail transportation and trucking in the United States.
